title: The Pastel Suite | Contemporary Bedroom Interior
subtitle: Multi-Zone Bedroom with Lounge, Study & Walk-in Dressing
description: A bedroom suite that holds four functions in one room. A sleeping area, lounge nook, study and walk-in dressing zone are separated by light and material rather than walls, in a soft palette of powder blue, warm white and concrete grey with rose-gold and brass details.
body:
This bedroom was planned as a self-contained suite for living, working and getting ready, not just for sleeping. Instead of building solid walls, we used a rose-gold framed fluted-glass partition to divide the room. It screens the dressing zone and still lets light and views pass through.

The curved bed is set against a concrete-textured feature wall framed by a soft-cornered, cove-lit recess. A watercolour botanical wall faces the bed and holds the TV. Across the room, a bouclé loveseat and a marble-and-brass table sit under a backlit sculptural relief, creating a quiet reading and conversation corner.

The study and wardrobe use a shared design language. Powder-blue fluted panelling, arched motifs and LED-lit open niches tie the joinery together. The dressing zone ends in an organic-shaped mirror over a curved floating vanity. Fluted glass shutters keep storage light and easy to see into.

Curves repeat across the ceiling, bed, mirror, desk and wardrobe arches. This gives the room a calm, continuous feel while each zone keeps its own clear purpose.
features.0.title: The Sleeping Zone
features.0.text: A curved, wing-sided upholstered bed with a quilted headboard sits against a concrete-textured feature wall, framed by a soft-cornered, cove-lit recess. Floating powder-blue side units and a brass ring wall sconce complete a calm, uncluttered composition, while sheer and blackout curtains give full control over daylight.
features.1.title: A Quiet Lounge Nook
features.1.text: Across the room, a curved bouclé loveseat and a round marble-top table on a fluted brass base create a corner for reading and conversation. A backlit sculptural relief panel anchors the space, and a chandelier-fan above gives the nook its own identity within the suite.
features.2.title: A Study Built Into the Wall
features.2.text: The floating powder-blue desk with a rounded fluted drawer is set against fluted panelling and a soft arched niche. LED-lit open shelves display books, while closed overhead storage keeps the workspace tidy and focused.
features.3.title: Wardrobe as a Feature Wall
features.3.text: Full-height wardrobe shutters carry a fluted arch inlay motif that repeats the curves found throughout the suite. LED-lit open niches break up the storage wall and display decor, while loft units add capacity without adding visual weight.
features.4.title: The Walk-in Dressing Zone
features.4.text: An organic-shaped mirror on a concrete-finish wall sits above a curved floating vanity with an upholstered pouf. Black-framed fluted glass cabinets keep storage light and easy to see into, and base drawers hold everyday essentials.
features.5.title: Dividing Without Walls
features.5.text: A rose-gold metal frame partition with fluted glass and integrated display ledges separates the dressing zone from the bedroom. It screens the area while still letting light and views pass through, so the suite reads as one open, connected room.
highlights.0.title: Rose-Gold Fluted Glass Partition
highlights.0.text: A semi-transparent divider that zones the room while keeping it open and bright.
highlights.1.title: Continuous Curved Language
highlights.1.text: Curves repeat across the ceiling, bed, mirror, desk and wardrobe arches for a calm, unified feel.
highlights.2.title: Layered Lighting
highlights.2.text: Perimeter cove lighting, recessed downlights, LED-lit niches and brass ring sconces.
highlights.3.title: Curated Material Palette
highlights.3.text: Concrete-texture panels, watercolour botanical wallcovering, Statuario-look flooring, bouclé and brass.
highlights.4.title: Four Functions, One Room
highlights.4.text: Sleeping, lounge, study and dressing zones planned within a single suite.
highlights.5.title: Integrated Joinery
highlights.5.text: Powder-blue fluted panelling ties the study, wardrobe, side units and vanity into one design system.
